name: Dr. Florian Korte
headline: Transformation & Commercial Leader | Driving Growth in Industrials & PE Portfolio Companies | Strategy → Execution | Ex-BCG
summary:
Contact: mail@fkorte.de

I lead transformation and commercial value creation initiatives in industrial and private equity environments - from strategy definition to execution on the ground.
 
My focus is on situations where performance needs to materially improve: growth acceleration, sales effectiveness, and complex transformation programs. I work closely with C-level stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams to translate strategic ambition into measurable results.
 
What I bring:
 
-  Strategy → Execution: Not just defining direction, but building the structures, governance and sales plays required to deliver impact 
-  Commercial impact: Driving revenue growth through focused sales strategies, value-based selling and operational enablement 
-  Transformation leadership: Setting up PMOs, aligning stakeholders and steering complex programs in dynamic, often PE-backed environments 
 
Selected impact:
 
-  +10% order intake (~€3m) in one year by refocusing sales strategy and coverage model 
-  ~€5m (>10%) sales uplift through PMO-led global improvement program 
-  Led cross-functional teams (10+ FTE) in transformation and carve-out environments with full Day 1 readiness 
 
Background: Former strategy consultant at BCG with experience across industrials, MedTech and technology-driven businesses.
